messages:
sam: Heads up — proposing we pause the v2 mobile canary rollout in eu-west due to spike in 500s. Can we hold the traffic switch?

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for service=api-gateway route=/v2/mobile at 2234567890 by release/2026-03-20. status=IN_PROGRESS :gear:

lisa: seeing 1.8% 500 rate in eu-west mobile after ~10% traffic. baseline was 0.1% before. stacktraces point to header-parsing NPE.

aj: :eyes: can you paste logs? if it's header parsing maybe fallback header changed in v2. We should pin route to v1 while we investigate.

lisa: pasted logs:
```
ERROR src/transport/header_parser.go: nil pointer at parseHeader+0x12f
... request.headers['x-client-meta'] sometimes null
```

maria: FYI mobile sdk teams: mobile apps with older SDKs won't send x-client-meta — that may be new required field. We need release notes and a soft-deprecation plan.

kevin: recommending fast workaround: route traffic for clients with header missing to v1 via header-gate. We can push header_gate=exists(x-client-meta) => route:v2 else route:v1

aj: I can flip routing rule. Command: ```rwctl route update api-gateway --cond "has_header:x-client-meta" --route v2 --else-route v1 --env canary-eu-west```

deploy-bot: action queued: route-update request id=rz-3321 user=aj status=QUEUED

sam: Hold on actual canary stop too — don't queue global changes. Can we pin only mobile-route *and* throttle? Suggest: pause canary traffic shift and set emergency pin for mobile-route.

aj: executed emergency pin: ```rwctl pin create api-gateway mobile-route --version v1 --duration 2h --reason "safety: header parsing NPE"``` status=SUCCESS

deploy-bot: pin created id=pin-7788 scope=mobile-route duration=7200s by aj at 2234568015

lisa: metrics stabilizing after pin, 500s dropping back to 0.12% :thumbsup:

maria: I'll draft release notes and cherrypick message to mobile SDK team. Also coordinating a small telemetry change to detect missing header and backfill.

kevin: quick check — any downstream A/B experiments reading v2 features? We should notify analytics.

sam: good catch thanks all. next steps: lisa + aj to root cause, maria to update notes + coord SDK message, kevin to flag analytics. We'll reassess at +1h. :white_check_mark:
